title: Three Terms and One Short Mat
subtitle: 学校教育 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 学校教育（人与自我·生活与学习·学校生活与学习）
meta: 主题语境：学校教育（人与自我·生活与学习·学校生活与学习）　|　核心词汇：gym　|　正文 342 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 gym 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1977 the coach ① opened a gym that no pupil in the school would have described, and he said the opening was the whole of the term. The ② gym, meaning the hall itself and not the field, ran three terms and stayed undescribed in the book; a gym, he said, is the only thing in a school that is judged by how long it is left undescribed.

Every ③ gym in that school had the same short mat beside it, and the ④ gym at the far end, meaning the one they kept for the children and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A gym, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to describe; the coach said the describing is the part that fills three terms.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the gym was the whole of the matter, meaning the exercise and not the hall. The ⑥ gym, meaning the exercise and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody describes; gym, he said, is either something you open or the only word that means both a hall and an exercise. He said the exercise is the part they remember.

By 1982 the ⑦ gym had become a line in a plan, and the plan had become an argument about the short mat. The ⑧ gym of the whole thing, the coach wrote in November, was one school and three terms of describing; gym, he said, is either the one at the far end or the reason you learned to describe. He said the describing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ gym I remember is the one described in the plan, which closed in 1984 and is still described as the quietest in the school. A ⑩ gym, my mother said in 1986, is the only one that improves by being described; every gym, she said, is an exercise that has agreed to look like a hall. She said the exercise was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 体育馆；健身房（指学校里每一座旁边的那一座）
B. n. 体育馆；健身房（指那座馆舍本身，与操场相对）
C. 固定搭配：open a gym 开办一座体育馆
D. n. 体育馆（指留给孩子们用的那一座）
E. n. 体育课；体操（抽象总称，指一所学校的体操之事）
F. n. 体育馆（指计划里写到、被记录过的那一座）
G. n. 体操课；体育锻炼（指一件事里人人都上却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 锻炼（抽象总称，指人人都练却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: opened a gym that no pupil in the school would have described
The gym, meaning the hall itself and not the field
the gym at the far end
the gym was the whole of the matter
the gym had become a line in a plan
The gym of the whole thing
A gym, my mother said in 1986

answers.why: open a gym 意为“开办一座体育馆”，1977 年那位教练开办了学校里没有一位学生肯描述的一座体育馆。
gym 意为“体育馆、健身房”，指那座馆舍本身而不是操场，它经过了三个学期而在簿子上没有被描述。
gym 意为“体育馆、健身房”，指学校里每一座旁边的那一座，每一座旁边都有同一块矮矮的垫子。
gym 意为“体育馆”，指最远端留给孩子们用的那一座，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
gym 意为“体操课、体育锻炼”，指一件事里人人都上却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这项锻炼就是那件事的全部。
gym 意为“锻炼”，指人人都练却无人提起的那样东西而不是那座体育馆，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
gym 意为“体育馆”，指计划里写到、被记录过的那一座，到 1982 年这一座成了计划里的一行。
gym 意为“体育课、体操”，教练十一月写道，整件事的体操之事是一处学校和三个学期的描述。
gym 意为“体育馆”，我记得的是计划里描述过的那一座，1984 年建成了，至今仍被说成学校里最安静的一座。
gym 为抽象总称，母亲 1986 年说，体育馆是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的场所。
